title: Clearer answers when Nano Banana declines an image
summary:
Clearer image-generation refusals and clearer ground rules for October contributors.

When Nano Banana returns no image, the image API now reports Gemini’s explanation when available, or its refusal reason instead of a generic error. It should be easier to tell why a request produced nothing.

Contribution guidelines now spell out the October 1–31 window, which issues count toward the event badge, and the merged-PR requirement for the Pollinations Contributor badge. A Code of Conduct sets out community standards. These are eligibility guidelines, not badge issuance.
